# Debris chunk: a squashed ico ball, half red half white. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Hull --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.8549 0.1412 0.1412 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Chunk --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.17
scale 1.3 0.8 0.9
apply --scale
material assign Trim
active Chunk
mode edit
select mode face
select none
select face where "pos.z > 0.02"
material assign Hull
mode object
shade flat
export chunk.glb
